reason: The plugin statically inspects existing AMDGPU code-object and ISA artifacts, exposing bounded metadata and instruction queries for debugging without compiling source or executing GPU code.

summaries.zh: 该插件读取现有的 AMDGPU HSACO 或 ELF 文件，并以有界 JSON 提供代码对象元数据和指令集查询结果。
summaries.en: This plugin reads existing AMDGPU HSACO or ELF artifacts and provides bounded JSON queries for code-object metadata and instruction information.

capabilities: Reads regular HSACO or AMDGPU ELF files from the host
Invokes llvm-readelf and llvm-objdump as child processes
Extracts and returns normalized AMDGPU metadata and instruction information as bounded JSON
